postings.title: CNC Technician/Operator (m/f/x)
postings.description:

- Inspect, measure, and document finished products for quality assurance

- Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workspace in line with 5S principles

postings.title: Customer Project Manager - European Space (m/f/x)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Join us as a Customer Project Manager (m/f/x) and support our Project Leads in delivering European space programs, institutional and commercial customers. As the key interface between customers and internal teams, you align customer expectations with project realities and ensure commitments are communicated clearly throughout the project lifecycle.

What awaits you at Mynaric

- Act as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned customers and manage expectations on scope, timelines, risks and status.
- Prepare and lead customer milestone reviews such as PDR and CDR, including review documentation and follow-up of customer actions.
- Support our technical Project Leads with schedules, risk registers and action logs, and make customer-impacting risks visible early.
- Create and own customer-facing documents such as the Project Management Plan and the Design, Development and Verification Plan in line with ECSS.
- Tailor ECSS requirements pragmatically to what a scale-up company can deliver, and align this approach with the customer.
- Track contractual deliverables, acceptance criteria and milestone payments including Contract Management with Finance, and manage changes, deviations and waivers.
- Coordinate customer-relevant activities during build, test and delivery with Production, Test Engineering, Quality and Logistics.
- Handle demanding customer situations with confidence and keep reporting, decisions and commitments clearly documented.

What you bring with you

- 3-7 years of experience in customer project management, program coordination or account delivery in space, aerospace, defence or a comparable high-tech industry.
- Hands-on experience applying and tailoring ECSS or comparable space standards in projects for ESA or other European space customers.
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field, including the technical curiosity to get into complex topics quickly
- Proficiency with project management tools and Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience in bridging established space processes and the realities of a dynamic company. Startup or scale-up experience is a plus.
- Excellent customer communication and the ability to find good solutions with demanding customers in negotiations.
- Skill in building trusted relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
- Clear and engaging presentation and reporting skills for customers and management.

What we offer you

Be part of the company that is changing the world!

postings.title: Environmental Test Engineer
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Join us as Environmental Test Engineer (m/f/x) and work with us on changing the future!

What awaits you at Mynaric

- You are responsible for the Environmental tests and our broad variety of high-end mechanical test equipment.
- Hands-on preparation of tests and their execution will be part of your tasks, as well as the test data acquisition, processing, analysis, and interpretation. As part of our environmental testing group, you elaborate test specifications and procedures in accordance to test standards and requirements in close cooperation with other teams. These tests setups include, but are not limited to:
- vibration tests (shaker)
- tensile tests
- gluing tests
- Thermal and TVAC Tests

- You keep our test equipment in top working shape in close coordination with our technical staff and the head of testing
- Extending the capabilities of our test facilities or building entirely new test setups might be part of your job.
- Depending on the type of test, you are preparing and finalizing the required documents for certification, production, or knowledge conservation. Updating test procedures and helping with proving data for reports.
- You provide input to our design team and the respective project teams from a testing perspective and feed their input back to the testing team.
- The communication with external partners for our tests can be part of your job

What you bring with you

- A hands-on, creative problem-solving mindset and the tenacity to see a challenge through.
- A university degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent professional experience.
- Significant hands-on experience in environmental testing, especiallythermal andthermal-vacuumtesting.

postings.title: Hardware Development Engineer (m/f/d)

postings.title: IT Lead (m/f/d)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

As our IT Lead you will lead and further develop our local IT organization while acting as the primary interface to Rocket Lab, our US-based parent company. This role is for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-moving manufacturing environment who can set strategic directions, coach a growing team, and roll up their sleeves when it counts.

What awaits you at Mynaric

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of junior and mid-level IT professionals,acting as a coach and role model who gives clear direction and fosters a culture of ownership
- Take overall responsibility for IT operations and strategy across our two Munich manufacturing sites, ensuring business continuity, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
- Own and continuously improve our ERP landscape, with a strong focus on SAP S/4HANA and its integration into business-critical processes.
- Drive the alignment and integration between ERP, MES, and shopfloor systems to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing operations.
- Serve as the primary IT liaison to our California-based parent company, Rocket Lab, with close collaboration across time zones
- Lead infrastructure, cybersecurity, digitalization, and manufacturing IT projects from concept through implementation.
- Manage IT budgets, vendors, and service providers with a strong focus on value creation, performance, and cost efficiency.
- Define and enforce security, risk, and compliance standards aligned with German regulations
- Act as an escalation point for major IT incidents and drive sustainable root-cause resolution
- Translate business and manufacturing requirements into a clear IT roadmap that supports growth, operational efficiency, and scalability.

What you bring with you

- Several years of leadership experience managing and developing IT teams, with a proven track record of building strong, engaged, and high-performing IT professionals.
- Strong expertise in ERP systems, ideally SAP S/4HANA, including governance, implementation, optimization, and business process integration.
- Good understanding of MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) and the interaction between ERP, production, engineering, quality, and supply chain processes.
- In-depth knowledge of security practices, frameworks, and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, NIST 800-53)
- Solid background managing hybrid IT landscapes, with Microsoft/Azure-based environments preferred
- Pragmatic, solution-oriented, and execution-focused mindset with a proven hands-on approach, actively supporting the team while effectively prioritizing in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
- High level of personal integrity, resilience, ownership, and authentic leadership behavior

What we offer you

postings.title: Kreditorenbuchhalter/Accounts Payable Accountant (m/w/d)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Bei Mynaric entwickeln wir innovative Laserkommunikationstechnologien, die eine schnelle und sichere Datenübertragung zwischen Luft-, Raumfahrt- und bodengestützten Systemen ermöglichen. Als Senior Kreditorenbuchhalter (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem internationalen Finance-Team. Du stellst einen reibungslosen und regelkonformen Kreditorenprozess sicher, treibst die Optimierung unserer Finanzabläufe voran und arbeitest eng mit internen sowie externen Stakeholdern weltweit zusammen.

What awaits you at Mynaric

- Eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung und Buchung sämtlicher Geschäftsvorfälle in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung sowie Sicherstellung einer termingerechten und korrekten Rechnungsverarbeitung.
- Steuerung, Überwachung und kontinuierliche Optimierung des digitalen Rechnungseingangs- und Freigabeprozesses in SAP S/4HANA und weiteren Workflow-Systemen.
- Vorbereitung und Durchführung nationaler sowie internationaler Zahlungsläufe einschließlich Verbuchung und Abstimmung von Banktransaktionen.
- Selbstständige Kontenabstimmung, Klärung offener Posten sowie professionelle Kommunikation mit nationalen und internationalen Lieferanten und internen Stakeholdern.
- Prüfung und Abrechnung von Reisekosten und Spesen unter Berücksichtigung steuerlicher und gesetzlicher Vorgaben.
- Aktive Mitwirkung bei Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS, inklusive Rückstellungsbildung und Abstimmungsarbeiten.
- Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen, Digitalisierung von Finanzprozessen sowie Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten, insbesondere im SAP S/4HANA-Umfeld.

What you bring with you

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Steuern sowie idealerweise eine weiterführende Qualifikation im Accounting-Bereich.
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Kreditoren- oder Finanzbuchhaltung, vorzugsweise in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA oder einem vergleichbaren ERP-System sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse.
- Gute Kenntnisse der Rechnungslegung nach HGB; Erfahrungen mit IFRS sind von Vorteil.
- Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Teamgeist und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Ansprechpartnern.
- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

What we offer you

Werde Teil des Unternehmens, das die Welt verändert!
Wolltest Du schon immer einmal in Deinem Lieblings-Weltraum-Outfit zur Arbeit kommen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Vergiss die Bürokratie und arbeite mit inspirierenden Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, während Du Dich mit Mynaric auf eine unglaubliche Reise begibst, um an einzigartigen und herausfordernden Projekten zu arbeiten und einen echten Beitrag zur Zukunft der Konnektivität zu leisten.

Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Freizeitausgleich, abwechslungsreiche Aufgabenbereiche und ein attraktives Gehaltspaket sowie zusätzliche Leistungen wie z.B.: ein Mobilitätsbudget (Jobticket, Business Bike, Tankgutschein), Sachzuwendung im Rahmen eines Einkaufsgutscheines, und Firmenevents.

Mynaric ist ein Arbeitgeber, der sich der Chancengleichheit verschrieben hat. Daher begrüßen wir Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Personen, unabhängig von ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Religion/Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter.

postings.title: Production Controller (m/w/d)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Als Production Controller (m/f/d) agierst du als Finance Business Partner für Operations und Supply Chain. Mit deinem Verständnis für Produktkosten, COGS, BOM und Profitabilität identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale und gestaltest die Kostentransparenz für unsere High-Tech-Produkte aktiv mit

What awaits you at Mynaric

- Du verantwortest das Product & Production Controlling für unsere High-Tech-Produkte und schaffst Transparenz über Kosten, Margen und Profitabilität entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
- Du analysierst und steuerst die Entwicklung von COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), Materialkosten, Fertigungskosten und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale zur nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Profitabilität.
- Du arbeitest eng mit Production, Supply Chain, und dem Projekt Management zusammen, um Kostenstrukturen zu verstehen und weiterzuentwickeln.
- Du verantwortest die Analyse und Validierung von Bill of Materials (BOM), Herstellkostenkalkulationen und Cost-Roll-ups und stellst die Nachvollziehbarkeit der Produktkosten sicher.
- Du analysierst Abweichungen zwischen Plan, Forecast und Ist sowie Kosten- und Margenentwicklungen und leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
- Du identifizierst Kostenrisiken und Volatilitäten in Materialpreisen, Lieferketten und Produktionsprozessen und und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Operations und Einkauf Gegenmaßnahmen
- Du unterstützt Budget-, Forecast- und Business-Case-Prozesse und entwickelst KPI- und Reportingstrukturen für fundierte Managemententscheidungen weiter.

What you bring with you

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Product Controlling, Manufacturing Controlling, Cost Controlling oder Operations Finance, idealerweise in einem produzierenden Industrieunternehmen.

postings.title: Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific (m/f/x)
postings.description:
Your way into the future

Shape the Future of Global Connectivity
At Mynaric, we're building the optical fiber for the skies.
As a pioneer in laser communications, we develop cutting-edge technology that enables ultra-fast, secure, and reliable data transmission between satellites, aircraft, drones, and terrestrial platforms. Our solutions are helping shape the future of aerospace, defense, and global communications networks.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific to accelerate our growth across one of the world's most dynamic aerospace and defense markets.
This is more than a sales role.
You will be the driving force behind expanding Mynaric's presence across Asia-Pacific, developing strategic customer relationships, identifying major business opportunities, and transforming qualified prospects into long-term partnerships. You will engage directly with senior executives, government stakeholders, defense organizations, system integrators, and innovative commercial space companies that are shaping the future of connectivity.
Just as importantly, you will remain actively involved after contract award, working closely with our Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to ensure customer expectations, program execution, and business objectives remain aligned throughout the customer journey.
If you are energized by complex sales cycles, strategic customer engagement, international business growth, and working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and mission-critical programs, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What awaits you at Mynaric

Drive Growth Across Asia-Pacific
You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities across government, defense, aerospace, satellite, and commercial markets throughout the region.
By building a deep understanding of customer priorities, market trends, and competitive landscapes, you will position Mynaric's solutions to solve critical challenges and create long-term value for our customers.

You will develop strong relationships with key decision-makers, program leaders, procurement organizations, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers understand how Mynaric's technology can support their strategic and operational objectives while creating opportunities for sustainable business growth.

Partner with Customers Throughout the Entire Lifecycle
Unlike traditional sales roles, your involvement does not end at contract signature.
You will work closely with the Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to support successful program execution, facilitate customer communications, participate in program reviews, and ensure alignment between contractual commitments, delivery milestones, and customer expectations.
Your ability to maintain trust during execution will be critical in driving customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term partnerships.

Lead Complex Sales and Capture Activities
You will own opportunities from initial market engagement through qualification, proposal development, negotiation, contract award, and expansion.
Working alongside Sales Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, and Executive Leadership, you will develop winning strategies that differentiate Mynaric and maximize customer value.

Influence the Future of Our Business
As the voice of the customer within Mynaric, you will bring market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback back into the organization to shape product development, strategic decision-making, and future growth initiatives.

What you bring with you

Experience

- 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, strategic account management, or capture management within the aerospace, defense, satellite, communications, or high-technology sectors.
- Experience developing business within Asia-Pacific markets and navigating complex customer and government environments.
- Proven success leading multi-stakeholder sales campaigns from opportunity identification through contract award.
- Strong commercial acumen and track record of delivering measurable business growth.

Leadership & Collaboration

- Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, from engineers and program managers to C-level executives and government decision-makers.
- Experience working successfully in a matrix organization with cross-functional teams.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with project delivery teams while maintaining a strong customer focus.
- Natural relationship builder who thrives on creating trust, alignment, and long-term partnerships.

Personal Attributes

- Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and strong commercial instincts.
- Customer-centric and passionate about solving complex challenges.
- Confident communicator and presenter with excellent negotiation skills.
- Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving international environment.
- Collaborative team player who enjoys working across functions and cultures.

Education & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Business, or a related discipline.
- MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification is an advantage.
- Experience with CRM and pipeline management tools.
- Fluent English is essential; additional Asia-Pacific languages are highly desirable.
- Willingness to travel internationally up to 50% of working time.
